Name: Upper Hall - PIF
Author: electroslime
Description:
[center][size=4][b]Hello![/b][/size][size=5][size=6][b]
[/b][/size][/size][size=2]I initially made this mod for a friend of mine who wanted to access their upstairs on a custom farmhouse but
couldn't due to the cabin warp issues in multiplayer.
So I designed and created a new map addition for them.

This mod adds an upstairs feature that can be turned into whatever you'd like.
It works for both cabins and farmhouse.
Read Personal Indoor Farm mod details for more placements.

[/size][size=4][b][u]Recolours[/u][/b][/size][size=2]

Currently I've only had time to make Vanilla and Vibrant Pastoral versions of the mod
If you have a recolour you want to see added just write it in the posts


[/size][size=4][b][u]How to Download[/u][/b]
[/size][size=2]1. Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20537]Personal Indoor Farm[/url]﻿
2. Download Rar.
3. Extract into mods folder. [/size][size=4]
[/size][size=2]4. Please refer to PIF's instructions for dimension door information[/size][size=4]
[/size][size=2]

I know there could be a few minor bugs I still have to fix so I'll get to it when i can.
These mostly amount to some rearranging of layers on my part
[/size][size=5]
[/size]plans for the future include:
-More customizable wall and floor placements
-possible bathroom upgrade
-DaisyNiko interior recolour
-Starblue recolour[/center]
